title: cress configuration
description: Schema for a cress site config file (cress.toml): the site metadata and the flat navigation list.

site.description: Site-wide metadata shared by every rendered page.

title.description: Site name, shown in the header and page titles.

description.description: Optional site tagline, exposed to templates (e.g. a meta description).

base_url.description: Canonical site root, e.g. "https://example.com". In-site links stay root-relative; this is exposed to templates for absolute links.

theme.description: Theme to render with. Empty resolves to the built-in default theme "cress". Any other name must match a directory under themes/.

logo.description: Path or URL to a logo image rendered in the navigation. Empty falls back to the theme's default logo. Typically a file in static/, e.g. "/logo.svg".

favicon.description: Path or URL to a favicon. Empty falls back to the theme's default favicon. Typically a file in static/, e.g. "/favicon.png".

accent.description: Accent color used as a soft highlight (e.g. on links). A CSS hex value; empty resolves to #9cb43b.

nav.description: Explicit, flat navigation as a table of label -> content file (e.g. Home = "index.md"). Entries appear in the order written.

additionalProperties.description: Content file the entry links to, relative to content/ (e.g. "about.md").
